inputs.question: Are electrical service lines/conduits shown routing from transformer pads to meters, and do these electrical routing paths stay entirely within the property boundary or enter the right-of-way/public area?
inputs.checklistItemText: Electrical routing from transformer to meter not 100% on private property
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent question asks whether electrical routing paths stay entirely within the property boundary or enter public areas—this requires visual inspection to determine the spatial relationship and clearance between the electrical conduit route and the property boundary line, which is a measurement/clearance task rather than a simple presence or label check.
